name: QMarkdown 1.2.0
body:
# QMarkdown 1.2.0

Package 1.2.0 / QML module 1.2 adds optional host-controlled code-block actions. Release date: 2026-10-12 UTC. Integration results are recorded in [iteration 032](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.2.0/specs/032-v1.2-integration/verification.md); publication and downloaded-asset results are recorded separately in [iteration 033](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/docs/v1.2.0-publication-evidence/specs/033-stable-v1.2-release/verification.md).

- Assign `MarkdownView.codeBlockActions` to an Item Component declaring `required property string codeText` and `required property var requestCopy`. Calling `requestCopy()` emits `codeBlockCopyRequested(string text)` on its owning view.
- Fenced, indented, nested and empty blocks receive exact parser text, including whitespace and trailing newlines, without fences/info strings or further normalization. Headers sit above code inside surface padding. Null remains the default and preserves existing rendering and dimensions.
- Component/block replacement, removal, zero width and view destruction invalidate old callbacks. Delegate creation failures diagnose while preserving code rendering. Hosts own spacing, styling, accessibility, clipboard and feedback; no Qt Quick Controls dependency is added to the library.
- The playground supplies a host clipboard helper and Copy/Copied control with keyboard, mouse and touch activation. Installed/relocated and distribution verification includes QML 1.0/1.1/1.2 consumers, linked and plugin-only where applicable.

Use `import QMarkdown 1.2` for the added contract. Existing 1.0/1.1 and unversioned consumers remain supported. Compatible CMake requests for 1.0/1.1/1.2 and EXACT 1.2.0 are accepted; EXACT 1.0.0/1.1.0 requires those historical packages. Linux amd64, Qt >=6.8, C++17 and CMake >=3.21 remain supported. Public QML/CMake behavior retains 1.x compatibility; private native classes have no public C++ ABI guarantee.

Legacy styling defaults and host navigation/resource ownership remain unchanged. HTML stays literal, PNG/JPEG images occupy separate rows, updates replace the document and indivisible glyphs may overhang narrow widths. Codecs cannot be interrupted; two busy workers may delay new work and shutdown may wait for codecs. Document-wide selection, inline-code actions, language labels, GFM, streaming, highlighting and generic renderer extensions remain deferred.

The release distributes an Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 archive built with Qt 6.8.0 and an Arch package. Verification checks the same minimum-built Ubuntu archive on Qt 6.8.0 and 6.12.0 and disposable Arch installation/ownership/consumers/upgrade/removal. Qt is not bundled; cross-runtime results are bounded evidence, not a portable binary guarantee. See [code-block actions](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.2.0/docs/code-block-actions.md), [Ubuntu installation](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.2.0/docs/release-install.md) and [Arch packaging](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.2.0/docs/arch-install.md).

Download both files for your distribution and verify its checksum before installation:

- Ubuntu: [archive](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/releases/download/v1.2.0/qmarkdown-1.2.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz), [SHA-256](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/releases/download/v1.2.0/qmarkdown-1.2.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz.sha256).
- Arch: [package](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/releases/download/v1.2.0/qmarkdown-1.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst), [SHA-256](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/releases/download/v1.2.0/qmarkdown-1.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst.sha256).

name: QMarkdown 1.1.0
body:
# QMarkdown 1.1.0

Package 1.1.0 / QML module 1.1 adds opt-in native styling while retaining Legacy defaults and existing QML 1.0 consumers. See [iteration 026 verification](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.1.0/specs/026-v1.1-integration/verification.md) for preceding candidate evidence; the final release commit receives fresh verification.

- Choose fixed `PolishedLight`, `PolishedDark`, `MinimalLight` or `MinimalDark` presets. Polished adds H1/H2 separators and code surfaces; Minimal keeps construction typography and spacing with decorations disabled. Presets do not subscribe to an application theme or paint a document background.
- Configure permanent `headings.h1`–`headings.h6`, `inlineCode` and `codeBlock` groups. Existing flat heading/font/color properties share the same state and notifications.
- Explicit assignments override preset values, including default values, false, zero and transparency. Individual grouped-property RESET clears one override; `resetOverrides()` restores the selected preset without detaching host QML bindings. Font edits retain whole-font overrides and resolve masks. Bind through one spelling of each aliased property.
- Native heading separators appear once per complete heading, including image rows. Inline-code backgrounds follow wrapped/bidirectional visual runs without changing text layout or link hit areas. Fenced/indented code remains literal native text with configurable surfaces, border, radius and padding.
- The playground includes preset/group controls and reset actions. Packaging verifies both 1.0 and 1.1 installed/relocated consumers on exact Qt 6.8.0 and 6.12.0; the minimum-built archive is checked on both runtimes.

Use `import QMarkdown 1.1` for the added API. Existing `import QMarkdown 1.0` and unversioned imports remain supported. CMake requests for 1.0 and 1.1 and EXACT 1.1.0 are accepted; EXACT 1.0.0 requires that historical package. Linux amd64, Qt >=6.8, C++17 and CMake >=3.21 remain the supported environment. Documented public QML behavior and CMake integration retain 1.x compatibility; private native classes have no public C++ ABI guarantee. Cross-runtime checks are bounded evidence, not a portable binary guarantee.

Hosts retain control of visual identity, backgrounds, scrolling, navigation and resource authorization. Parser/dependency/resource policy behavior is unchanged. HTML remains literal; PNG/JPEG images occupy separate rows; updates replace the full document; indivisible glyphs may overhang narrow widths. Active codecs cannot be interrupted, two busy workers may delay new work, and application shutdown may wait for codecs.

Selection/copy, GFM, streaming, highlighting, renderer extensions, inline-code padding/borders and arbitrary style inheritance remain deferred. See the [styling guide](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.1.0/docs/styling.md) for palettes, metrics, aliases and reset examples.

## Installation

Download `qmarkdown-1.1.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz` and its `.sha256` companion from this release. Assets appear after the publication workflow completes. The Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 archive is built with Qt 6.8.0 and checked on exact Qt 6.8.0 and 6.12.0. Qt is not bundled.

```sh
sha256sum -c qmarkdown-1.1.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz.sha256
tar -xzf qmarkdown-1.1.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz
cd qmarkdown-1.1.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8
sudo ./install.sh
# Remove using the retained extracted package:
sudo ./uninstall.sh
```

Provide compatible Qt Core, Gui, Qml, Quick and Network libraries and Ubuntu dependencies, Python 3.9+, readlink, sudo and ldconfig. Development consumers need a matching Qt SDK, CMake >=3.21 and a C++17 compiler. The installer tracks its owned files and refuses conflicts or modifications before installation; uninstall preserves modified files. This is a manually owned package, not a dpkg package.

See [complete binary installation instructions](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.1.0/docs/release-install.md) for discovery, ownership and staging. Alternatively, build shared or static libraries using the [README](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.1.0/README.md).

name: QMarkdown 1.0.0
body:
# QMarkdown 1.0.0

First stable release of the independent native Qt Quick Markdown library. Markdown is parsed privately with bundled cmark 0.31.2 and rendered through native blocks and inline layout. Host applications own typography, colors, scrolling, navigation and resource authorization. All 652 pinned CommonMark examples pass parser and model semantic checks; native presentation has separate representative verification.

## Supported environments and compatibility

Source support: Linux amd64, Qt >=6.8, C++17, CMake >=3.21. Verification is pinned to Qt 6.8.0 and 6.11.3. Documented MarkdownView, MarkdownStyle, MarkdownResourcePolicy QML properties, signals and behavior, and CMake integration remain compatible throughout 1.x. Implementation classes and QMarkdown.Private are private; no public C++ headers or C++ ABI guarantee.

The binary archive targets Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, is built with Qt 6.8.0, and is tested with the same binary on Qt 6.11.3. Qt is not bundled; this is specific tested compatibility, not a guarantee for other distributions or runtimes.

## Installation

Download `qmarkdown-1.0.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz` and its `.sha256` companion from this release. Assets appear after the publication workflow completes.

```sh
sha256sum -c qmarkdown-1.0.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz.sha256
tar -xzf qmarkdown-1.0.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8.tar.gz
cd qmarkdown-1.0.0-ubuntu24.04-x86_64-qt6.8
sudo ./install.sh
# Remove using the retained extracted package:
sudo ./uninstall.sh
```

Provide compatible Qt Core, Gui, Qml, Quick and Network libraries and Ubuntu dependencies, Python 3.9+, readlink, sudo and ldconfig. Development requires the matching Qt SDK, CMake and a C++17 compiler. The installer tracks its own files and refuses conflicting or modified files before installation; uninstall preserves modified files. This is a manually owned package.

See [complete binary installation instructions](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.0.0/docs/release-install.md) for runtime discovery, ownership and staging. Alternatively, build shared or static libraries using the [README](https://github.com/lebedenko/qmarkdown/blob/v1.0.0/README.md).

## Migration from 0.7

Change `import QMarkdown 0.7` to `import QMarkdown 1.0` (or an unversioned import), and `find_package(QMarkdown 0.7 CONFIG REQUIRED)` to `find_package(QMarkdown 1.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)`. Link `QMarkdown::QMarkdown`. No legacy 0.x aliases remain. 1.0.0 accepts CMake requests for 1.0 and exact 1.0.0; it rejects 0.7, 1.1 and 2.0.

## Accepted limitations

Images occupy separate rows and support only authorized PNG/JPEG resources; resources are denied by default. HTML remains literal. Markdown changes replace the full document model. Indivisible glyphs can overhang extremely narrow widths. Codecs cannot be interrupted; two occupied decoder workers can delay fresh work, and application shutdown can wait for codecs. GFM extensions, streaming, selection/copy, renderer extensions, further optimization and broader platform support remain deferred.
